protocol.method: image-derived coarse-to-fine rotation support hypotheses, reciprocal WGSL matching, then per-window local affine WGSL RANSAC and seeded IC-GN
protocol.analytic_truth_usage: final scoring and oracle control only; no truth used to select angles, descriptor matches, or local affine models
protocol.field_scope: smooth heterogeneous synthetic fields; discontinuities intentionally excluded from this first local-model test

local_model_fit.coefficients_order: WGSL target map [a1,a2,a0,unused,b1,b2,b0,unused], converted to IC-GN affine order
